sentences.text: 1. Suresh Kumar S/o Bastimal, Aged About 49 Years, R/o  Shivganj, Police Station Shivganj, Dist. Sirohi.
2. Bastimal S/o Devichand, Aged About 49 Years, R/o  Shivganj, Police Station Shivganj, Dist. Sirohi.

(Presently Lodged At Sub Jail, Sirohi)
 ----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Pritam Solanki For Respondent(s) : Mr. Lalit Kishor Sen, PP
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI Order 09/10/2024 1.

Through this bail application, accused have come before this Court for grant of bail under section 483 of BNSS (Section 439 of the old Code) in connection with crime registered pursuant to First Information Report No.99/2022 of Police Station Mandar, District Sirohi in respect of offences punishable under Sections 420 and 406 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2. I have considered the rival submissions of learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the record.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has strongly objected the different submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants and submitted that in the facts of the present case, it is expedient that accused be kept in the custody.
He thus, craves rejection of the applicant's bail application.
4. I have given my anxious consideration to the rival submissions with reference to material placed before me.

sentences.text: On perusal of the record, it would be prima facie clear that present dispute appears to be of a business and commercial transaction.
Petitioners are in custody since 09.09.2024.
The case is exclusively triable by Magistrate court and trial of the case will take sufficient time to conclude.
Therefore, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for grant of indulgence of bail to the petitioners.

6. Consequently, the present bail application is allowed and it is directed that the accused-petitioners Suresh Kumar S/o Bastimal and Bastimal S/o Devichand, arrested in connection with the F.I.R. No. 99/2022 of Police Station Mandar, District Sirohi shall be released on bail provided each of them furnish a personal bond and two surety bonds of sufficient amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

This order is subject to the condition that accused,
within 7 days of their release, and sureties on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts, with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as copy of front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 171-minki/-
